description: 西北太平洋海域氣候海水位-西北太平洋海域CMEMS衛星 0.125度網格氣候海水位 [flood] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 交通部中央氣象署. 統計1994-2023年西北太平洋海域CMEMS衛星 0. 125度網格氣候海水位資料。 如需大量下載資料者請至氣象資料開放平臺申請會員 cwa. gov. tw/index. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 交通部中央氣象署. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-12-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
